text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for this! Finally, it's
time for the
Unicorn Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Dirt or not—if it's a mile race, I ain't
losin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You betcha! Just leave it to me!
choice_data_list: 貴方の力を信じてるよ！

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Don't matter what kinda track it is, or
who's on it!
I ain't fixin' to be beat!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gunning for the Mile Championship,
meaning I
gotta take this one too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm gonna run so fast, it'll
blow
everybody's socks off!
choice_data_list: タイキシャトルの力を見せつけよう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's show off Taiki Shuttle's strength!
